objective: Prevent known prepared development cases from entering a protected fresh confirmation cohort while full cross-campaign exposure reconciliation continues.
inputs: Immediate directory entry names/types in private WSL archive roots matching g01-,g02-,g03-,defects4j-. Only exact known Defects4J project/positive numeric bug identities and checkout/baseline/index suffixes recognized. No symlinks followed, file contents or labels read.
outputs: Deduplicated conservative prepared-case exclusions with per-origin listing digests, unresolved identities and explicit incomplete-union posture. Case-named directory does not prove provider dispatch; it conservatively excludes prepared source anyway.
correction_to_prior_context: Four existing source cohorts contribute32+32+32+30 distinct prepared cases, not just the two cohorts described in the earlier confirmation note. Canonical16 are included in the third cohort. This does not establish a complete cross-campaign union or a fresh count.
remaining_reconciliation: Recognize label-free prepared/dispatched manifest identity fields that do not have case-named directories
Inventory older removed/remote campaign records without following secrets/provider transcripts
Map cross-dataset issue/revision identities to pinned active bug metadata where justified
Distinguish case-level exposure from same-repository dependence and unknown model pretraining
Freeze a complete selected dependency inventory before any protected cohort selection
qualification: Three synthetic tests cover exact aliases, deduplication, deterministic ordering, unknown IDs, files/symlinks, bounds and fail-closed fresh selection. Freeze implementation/tests/protocol then emit private runtime census receipt; no providers or evaluator labels.
claim_ceiling: Conservative known exclusion lower bound only, not complete exposure audit or superiority
open_questions: Which additional prepared/dispatched cases exist only in manifests or external archives?
Can the full union be certified without reading gold or future-fix evidence?
Which target population is task-disjoint and supports appropriate repository-clustered uncertainty?
